data.one_liner: Retrieve app info and present the App Store inside your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to retrieve app details and version information from the App Store. It also lets users view app details directly within the app using SKStoreProductViewController on iOS.
use_when: You need to check for app updates by comparing the App Store version with the installed version.
You want to present the App Store product view controller directly inside your iOS app.
avoid_when: You are targeting Android or platforms other than iOS.
You need to test the functionality on an iOS simulator (it only executes on a real iOS device).
strengths: Provides in-app App Store viewing via SKStoreProductViewController.
Allows checking for app updates by comparing store and installed versions.
weaknesses: Only executes on a real iOS device and does not work on the iOS simulator.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Note that the code will only execute on a real iOS device and not on the iOS simulator.
